item.title: Dismissal of Indictment Becomes Election Issue… Ruling Party Says “What’s the Problem?” Opposition Says “Destruction of Rule of Law” (선거 쟁점 된 공소 취소… 與 “뭔 문제냐” 野 “법치 파괴”)
item.description:
Dismissal of Indictment Becomes Election Issue… Ruling Party Says “What’s the Problem?” Opposition Says “Destruction of Rule of Law” (선거 쟁점 된 공소 취소… 與 “뭔 문제냐” 野 “법치 파괴”)

Ahead of the June 3 local elections, the Democratic Party of Korea’s “insurrection judgment theory” and the People Power Party’s “dictatorship prevention theory” are clashing. On the 11th, the Democratic Party of Korea held its first Central Election Countermeasures Committee meeting and placed “judgment of insurrection forces” at the forefront of its election campaign. The People Power Party has characterized the ruling party’s governance as “dictatorship,” citing the push for a special counsel law that could allow the dismissal of the indictment in President Lee Jae-myung’s case, and called for judgment at the local elections. The People Power Party plans to launch its election committee this week and establish a response body for the dismissal of the indictment. <<> Democratic Party leader Chung Cheong-rae held the first election committee meeting in Chuncheon, Gangwon Province, on this day and appointed citizen Yoo Chung-won, who blocked armored vehicles in front of the National Assembly during the December 3 martial law, as a co-chairman of the election committee. Leader Chung stated, “On this path to overcoming insurrection and normalizing the nation, it is to convey public sentiment from that perspective.” <<> The name of the Democratic Party’s election committee, which officially launched the previous day, is the “Election Committee for National Normalization of the Republic of Korea.” Besides Leader Chung, former Constitutional Court Justice Kim Yi-su, who served as the head of the legal representative team for the National Assembly’s impeachment committee against President Yoon Seok-youl, was appointed as a co-chairman overseeing overall operations. <<> As the local elections approach, the opposition has been increasingly attacking the People Power Party as an “insurrection force.” When the Democratic Party, in its push for constitutional amendments, failed to meet the quorum for a vote despite the People Power Party’s demand to “pursue it after the local elections,” the Democratic Party accused them of being “confirmed as an insurrection force.” When the People Power Party criticized the government’s response regarding the Korean HMM ship “Namu-ho,” which was attacked in the Strait of Hormuz, Democratic Party lawmaker Kang Deuk-gu denounced, “The People Power Party is using the people’s safety as a political tool. They are indeed the insurrection party.” <<> The opposition, including the People Power Party, is mobilizing its support base by leveraging the controversy over the special counsel law that enabled the dismissal of the indictment in President Lee’s case. People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk recently stated, “We must end the Lee Jae-myung dictatorship regime in the local elections.” At a party meeting on this day, Leader Jang also said, “The entire nation clearly knows what Lee Jae-myung is doing to erase his crimes,” and added, “Judgment must come through the anger of the sovereign people.” <<> The controversy over the dismissal of the indictment is also growing among candidates. Many Democratic Party local election candidates have distanced themselves from the controversy as public opinion worsened, stating it is “an issue to discuss after the election” or “a matter for the National Assembly.” However, Democratic Party Gyeonggi Province governor candidate Choo Mi-ae said on MBC radio on this day, “If the investigation clearly reveals the truth of the fabricated indictment, it is only natural to restore the honor of those who suffered unfairly,” and added, “I would like to ask why urging that is considered wrong.” <<> Candidate Choo’s remarks came in the process of refuting criticism from opposition Gyeonggi Province governor candidates. People Power Party Gyeonggi Province governor candidate Yang Hyang-ja stated in a media interview, “The people will not simply watch the Democratic Party’s push for the special counsel law,” and added, “I will throw my entire being into blocking this unreasonable attempt to erase the president’s crimes.” Reform Party Gyeonggi Province governor candidate Cho Eung-cheon also remarked, “This ‘I’ll do as I please’ mindset is precisely the hallmark of dictatorial power.” <<> Democratic Party Seoul mayoral candidate Jung Won-oh said on CBS radio regarding the special counsel law, “If the Seoul mayor constantly voices opinions on political issues and steps into the center of political strife, citizens will suffer.” He added, “One should not be absorbed in political strife.” In response, People Power Party Seoul mayoral candidate Oh Se-hoon told this publication in a phone call, “The special counsel law destroys the separation of powers and the rule of law, and is a frontal challenge to the constitutional order,” adding, “This election is the last line of defense to stop the Democratic Party’s power run.” Jo Guk, candidate of the Rebuilding Korea Party running in a by-election for the National Assembly seat in Pyeongtaek, Gyeonggi, responded to a related question on the radio by saying, “I haven’t looked at the special counsel bill in detail due to campaigning,” and added, “It should be discussed and handled after the election, ensuring there are no unconstitutional elements.” <<> The local election landscape, which had seen forecasts of the Democratic Party sweeping the nation except for Gyeongbuk, is now showing a close race within or near the margin of error in recent polls, particularly in areas like Daegu, Busan, and Gyeongnam. Polling experts are also noting the impact of the Lee Jae-myung administration’s real estate policies in the capital region. In political circles, there are predictions that “in the remaining 20-plus days, two entirely different judgment theories will clash head-on,” and that “a mix of mid-term evaluations of the one-year-old Lee Jae-myung administration and assessments of the hardline-focused ‘Chung Cheong-rae-led Democratic Party system’” will emerge. (6·3 지방선거를 앞두고 더불어민주당의 ‘내란 심판론’과 국민의힘의 ‘독재 저지론’이 격돌하고 있다. 더불어민주당은 11일 중앙선거대책위원회 첫 회의를 열고 ‘내란 세력 심판’을 선거 캠페인 전면에 내세웠다. 국민의힘은 여당이 이재명 대통령 사건을 공소취소할 수 있는 특검법 추진하는 등 여권의 국정 운영을 ‘독재’로 규정하고 지방선거로 심판해 달라고 했다. 국민의힘은 이번 주 선대위를 출범하고 공소취소 대응 기구를 발족할 예정이다.)

item.title: Opposition: "The culprit confessed, but the victim says it wasn't him; did a UFO shoot it?" (野 “때린 놈 자백에도 맞은 사람이 아니라 해, UFO가 쐈나”)
item.description:
Opposition: "The culprit confessed, but the victim says it wasn't him; did a UFO shoot it?" (野 “때린 놈 자백에도 맞은 사람이 아니라 해, UFO가 쐈나”)

Following the government's conclusion that the fire on the HMM 'Namu' while anchored in the Strait of Hormuz was caused by an "attack," the People Power Party demanded on the 11th that related standing committees, such as the National Assembly's Foreign Affairs and Unification Committee and the National Defense Committee, be convened immediately. (호르무즈 해협 정박 중인 HMM ‘나무호’의 화재 원인이 ‘피격’이라는 정부 결론이 나오자, 국민의힘은 11일 국회 외교통일위원회·국방위원회 등 관련 상임위를 곧바로 소집해야 한다고 요구했다.)

In response, the Democratic Party of Korea rejected this, stating, "We need to wait for the government's investigation results." The Democratic Party, citing that the official campaign for the June 3 local elections begins on the 21st, suggests holding the standing committee meetings around the 19th or 20th. (이에 대해 더불어민주당은 “정부의 조사 결과를 기다려야 한다”며 거부했다. 민주당은 6·3 지방선거 공식 유세가 21일부터 시작인 점을 이유로 19~20일쯤 상임위를 열자는 입장이다.)

People Power Party lawmakers on the Foreign Affairs Committee held a press conference on the same day, arguing, "Immediately after the incident, the ruling party refused to hold a meeting citing 'confirming whether an external attack occurred' as a priority. After the official announcement (of the attack), they are delaying the meeting on the grounds that 'the attacker has not been identified.'" They accused the ruling party of "trying to avoid inconvenient diplomatic and security issues, mindful of the elections," and proposed holding a meeting on the 13th. (외통위 소속 국민의힘 의원들은 이날 기자회견을 열어 “사건 직후 여당은 ‘외부 피격 여부 확인이 우선’이라는 이유로 회의 개최를 거부해 왔다. (피격) 공식 발표 이후에는 ‘공격 주체가 특정되지 않았다’는 이유로 회의를 미루고 있다”고 반발했다. 이들은 “선거를 의식해 불리한 외교·안보 이슈를 회피하려는 의도”라며 13일에 회의를 열자고 했다.)

People Power Party members on the National Defense Committee stated, "The Ministry of National Defense has not been responding at all to the defense committee members' requests for briefings. If they realize the seriousness of the situation, they should respond immediately." The People Power Party held a plenary session of the National Defense Committee in the afternoon, but the government and ruling party side did not attend. Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk said at a party meeting, "Iran's state TV reported that the target was a Korean ship. The perpetrator is confessing, but the victim says it's not him. Was there a UFO attack?" (국민의힘 국방위원들은 “국방부가 국방위원들의 보고 요구에 전혀 응답하지 않고 있었다”며 “상황의 심각성을 깨닫고 있다면 즉각 응해달라”고 했다. 국민의힘은 이날 오후 국방위 전체회의를 개최했으나 정부·여당 측은 불참했다. 장동혁 대표는 당 회의에서 “이란 국영TV가 한국 선박을 표적으로 삼았다고 보도했다. 때린 놈이 자백하는데도 맞은 사람이 아니라고 하는 것이다. UFO 공격이라도 있었다는 건가”라고 했다.)

However, Democratic Party lawmakers on the Foreign Affairs Committee countered, "They are stoking political conflict even before the investigation results are clear." They added, "Rashly identifying the attacker without clear scientific evidence is an amateurish and extremely dangerous act that could put the 26 ships passing through the Strait of Hormuz at serious risk. It is more in the national interest to hold the standing committee meetings only after the government's investigation is fully complete." (그러나 외통위 소속 민주당 의원들은 “정확한 조사 결과가 나오기도 전에 정쟁 군불부터 때고 있다”고 했다. 이들은 “명확한 과학적 증거 없이 섣부르게 공격 주체를 특정하는 것이야말로 호르무즈 해협을 지나는 우리 선박 26척을 심각한 위험에 빠뜨리는 아마추어적이고 위험천만한 짓”이라며 “정부의 조사가 모두 끝나고 난 뒤 상임위를 개최하는 것이 국익에 더 부합한다”고 했다.)

Observers in political circles noted that the roles have reversed compared to the Yoon Suk Yeol administration. In April 2023, when allegations emerged that US intelligence agencies had bugged the Yongsan presidential office, the then-opposition Democratic Party pressured the People Power Party to hold related standing committee meetings, and the Foreign Affairs Committee promptly held sessions questioning the Minister of Foreign Affairs and others from both parties. (정치권에서는 윤석열 정부 때와 공수가 뒤바뀌었다는 지적이 나왔다. 2023년 4월에는 미국 정보기관의 용산 대통령실 도청 의혹이 불거져 야당이던 민주당이 관련 상임위를 열어야 한다며 국민의힘을 압박했고, 곧바로 외통위에서 외교부 장관 등을 상대로 여야의 질의가 진행됐다.)

item.title: Blue House: “Unknown How Long It Will Take to Determine Attacker” (靑 “공격 주체 판단 얼마나 걸릴지 몰라”)
item.description:
Blue House: “Unknown How Long It Will Take to Determine Attacker” (靑 “공격 주체 판단 얼마나 걸릴지 몰라”)

Regarding the HMM NAMUHO, which was attacked in the Strait of Hormuz on the 4th, National Security Advisor Seo Wook said on the 11th, “Considering the damage patterns from explosion pressure and the hemispherical penetration shapes, the likelihood of an attack by mines or torpedoes appears low.” However, he added that “additional investigation is needed” to identify the means or perpetrator behind the attack on the NAMUHO, suggesting that it will take a significant amount of time. (호르무즈 해협에서 지난 4일 피격된 HMM 나무호에 대해 위성락 국가안보실장은 11일 “폭발 압력으로 인한 파손 패턴과 반구형 관통 형상 부위를 고려할 때 기뢰 및 어뢰에 의한 피격 가능성은 낮은 것으로 보인다”고 했다. 그러나 나무호를 공격한 수단이나 주체 규명에는 “추가적인 조사가 필요한 상황”이라고 해 상당한 시간이 소요될 전망이다.)

A senior Blue House official responded to a press question about “how long it will take to determine the attacker” by saying, “I don’t know.” The official stated, “We have collected the necessary debris, and for a more professional analysis, we need to disassemble the debris and conduct physical and chemical inspections.” (이날 청와대 고위 관계자는 ‘공격 주체 판단은 얼마나 걸리나’라는 언론 질의에 “모른다”고 답했다. 이 관계자는 “필요한 잔해를 수거했고, 좀 더 전문적으로 보려면 잔해를 분해하고 물리·화학적 검사도 필요하다”며 이같이 말했다.)

Experts say that the analysis period and forensic results vary depending on what debris is collected on the ship, and if debris from the aircraft’s engine remains, it could make identifying the attacker easier. Yang Wook, a research fellow at the Asan Institute for Policy Studies, said, “If we can accurately identify the engine of the attack means, we can largely pinpoint the type of weapon and its country of origin.” (전문가들은 선내에서 어떤 잔해가 수집됐는지에 따라 분석 기간이나 감식 결과가 달라진다며, 비행체 엔진 잔해가 남아 있다면 공격 주체 파악이 수월해질 것으로 보고 있다. 양욱 아산정책연구원 연구위원은 “공격 수단의 엔진을 정확히 식별하면 공격 무기의 종류와 생산 국가를 상당 부분 특정할 수 있다”고 했다.)

If debris from a piston-type engine commonly used in vehicles is found, it would lend weight to the possibility of an Iranian Shahed-series drone. Lee Il-woo, secretary general of the Korea Defense Network, said, “Shahed drones have left substantial engine debris in many cases, so identification wouldn’t be difficult,” adding, “Some newer Shahed models use jet engines, but even those can be identified.” If debris from a jet engine different from the Shahed engines is found, the possibility of an attack by jet-engine cruise missiles or surface-to-ship/ship-to-ship missiles cannot be ruled out. (차량에서 쓰는 피스톤식 엔진 잔해가 발견됐다면, 이란의 샤헤드 계열 드론일 가능성에 무게가 실린다. 이일우 자주국방네트워크 사무국장은 “샤헤드 드론은 엔진 잔해가 많이 보고돼 있어 확인이 어렵지 않을 것”이라며 “최신형 샤헤드 중 제트엔진을 사용한 모델도 있지만 이 경우에도 식별할 수 있다”고 했다. 만약 샤헤드 엔진과는 다른 형태의 제트엔진 잔해가 발견됐다면, 제트엔진을 사용하는 순항미사일이나 지대함·함대함 미사일 공격 가능성을 배제할 수 없게 된다.)

If the engine and debris are severely damaged, making it difficult to identify the entity, it could take considerable time to determine the attack method and perpetrator, or identification may become impossible. In that case, footage of the flying object captured by the security camera (CCTV) facing the stern of the NAMUHO could serve as a clue, but it is less definitive than debris. A military source said, “For drones, the shape of the flying object captured on CCTV can allow for some level of identification, but for anti-ship missiles, which are very fast, analysis at the CCTV level may be difficult.” (엔진과 잔해가 심하게 훼손돼 실체 파악이 어려울 경우, 공격 방식 및 주체를 특정하는 데 상당 시간이 걸리거나 특정이 어려워질 수도 있다. 이 경우 나무호 후미를 향하고 있던 보안카메라(CCTV)에 촬영된 비행체 영상이 단서가 될 수 있지만, 잔해만큼 확실하지는 않다. 군 소식통은 “드론의 경우 CCTV에 잡힌 비행체 형체만으로도 어느 정도 특정이 가능하지만, 대함 미사일 등은 속도가 워낙 빨라 CCTV 수준으로는 분석하기 어려울 수 있다”고 했다.)

item.title: "None of the rulers amended the constitution for the people" (“집권자 중 누구도 국민을 위해 헌법을 고치지 않았다”)
item.description:
"None of the rulers amended the constitution for the people" (“집권자 중 누구도 국민을 위해 헌법을 고치지 않았다”)

On July 17, 1982, Constitution Day, YS reflects on the constitution. He recalls that in the 34 years since its enactment in 1948, it had been amended seven times. He writes that the constitutional amendments were not for the people. (YS는 1982년 7월 17일 제헌절에 헌법에 대해 생각합니다. 1948년 헌법 제정 후 34년간 일곱 차례 개정한 사실을 떠올립니다. 헌법 개정은 국민을 위한 것이 아니었다고 적었습니다.)

"In the process of changing it seven times, not once was the constitution truly amended for the public. Any ruler amended the constitution for one of a few reasons. First, for national security due to the threat from North Korea. Second, to further strengthen dictatorship. Third, out of the belief that no one else could do it but me." (“일곱 번 바꾸는 과정에서 단 한 번도 진실로 국민 대중을 위하여 헌법을 바꾼 일은 없었다. 어느 집권자이든 서너 가지의 이유 때문에 헌법을 고쳤다. 첫째, 북한의 위협 때문에 안보를 위해서. 둘째, 독재를 더 강화하기 위해서. 셋째, 나 아니면 안 되겠다는 생각에서다.”)

YS recorded many deaths around this time. Bashir Gemayel, the President-elect of Lebanon, was killed in a terrorist bombing. Princess Grace of Monaco died in a car accident. Actress Ingrid Bergman also passed away. (YS는 이 무렵의 사망 사건을 다수 기록했습니다. 레바논 대통령 당선자인 바시르 게마엘이 테러로 폭사했습니다. 모나코 왕비 그레이스 켈리는 자동차 사고로 죽었습니다. 배우 잉그리드 버그먼도 사망합니다.)

"All humans die. But especially those who hold power forget that they themselves will die before long. If they remembered that they would die, they would not engage in such dictatorial politics that inflict suffering on everyone." (“인간은 누구나가 죽는 것이다. 그런데 특히 권력을 잡은 자들은 자기가 얼마 가지 않아 죽는다는 사실을 잊어버린다. 죽는다는 사실을 기억한다면 이러한 만인에게 고통을 주는 독재정치는 아니 할 것이기 때문이다.”)

This morning, I received a phone call from Assemblyman Kim Dong-young. He said, "How are you? It's quite a situation to be under house arrest like this, even on Constitution Day." My reply was, "That's right. It's not others but they themselves who trample on the constitution." (오늘 아침에 김동영(金東英) 의원(議員)으로부터 전화(電話)가 왔다. “어떻게 지내십니까? 오늘은 제헌절(制憲節)인데도 그렇게 연금 상태(狀態)에 있어(*으)니 참 큰일입니다”라고 하는 내용(內容)이였다. “그렇게 말이야 헌법(憲法)은 딴 사람 아닌 자기(自己)네들이 짓밟고 말이야”하는 것이 나의 대답이였다.)

Indeed, that is true. It has already been 34 years since the constitution was enacted. Thirty-four years may seem long if you think so, but in the grand scope of human history, it is not such a long time. During that period, this country changed its constitution seven times. In the process of changing it seven times, not once was the constitution truly amended for the public. (사실(事実) 그렇다. 헌법(憲法)을 제정(制定)한지도 어언 34년전(年前)의 일이다. 34년(年)을 길다고 생각하면 길지마는 인류(人類)의 역사(歷史)를 길게 생각하면 그렇게 긴 세월(才月)도 아니다. 그동안 이 나라에서는 일곱 번 헌법(憲法)을 바꾸웠(*었)다. 일곱 번 바꾸는 가정(*과정)에서 단 한번도 진실(眞實)로 국민(囗民) 대중(大衆)을 위하여 헌법(憲法)을 바꾼 일은 없었다.)

Every ruler amended the constitution for one of a few reasons. (어느 집권자(執權者)이던(*든) 서너 가지의 이유(理由) 때문에 헌법(憲法)을 고쳤다.)

First, for national security due to the threat from North Korea. (첫째로 북한(北韓)의 위협 때문에 안보(安保)를 위해서.)

Second, to further strengthen dictatorship. (둘째로 독재(獨裁)를 더 강화(强化)하기 위해서.)

Third, out of the belief that no one else could do it but me. The belief that it could not be handed over to anyone else, like an object. (셋째로 나 아니면 안 되겠다는 생각에서다. 물건(物件) 모양으로 나 외(外)의 어느 누구에게도 줄 수 없다는 생각에서다.)

Both Dr. Syngman Rhee and Mr. Park Chung-hee were like that, and it is still the same now. (이승만(李承晩) 박사(博士)도 박정희(朴正熙) 씨(氏)도 지금도 다 그러하다.)

Whenever and whatever government it may be, they tell the people to uphold the constitution. They force everyone to obey all laws. But those who destroyed the constitution are not the people, but the rulers or the tyrannical wielders of power. (언제나 어느 때 정부(政府)이고 간에 국민(囗民)들어(*더러) 헌법(憲法)을 지키라고 말한다. 모든 법(法)을 지키라고 강요(强要)한다. 그러나 헌법(憲法)을 파괴해 버린 사람은 국민(囗民)이 아니라 집권자(執權者)요 그렇지 않으면 권력(權力)을 가진 폭군(暴君)이였다.)

They have manipulated the constitution, silencing opposition and press with guns, swords, or martial law, ignoring the dissenting opinions of many, imprisoning or placing countless citizens under house arrest. (총과 칼이 아니면 계엄령(戒嚴令)으로 국민(囗民)의 반대(反對)와 언론(言論)을 침묵시킨 가운데 많은 사람들의 반대(反對) 의견(意見)을 묵살하고 또한 많은 국민(囗民)을 감옥에 넣거나 연금 시킨 가운데 헌법(憲法)을 조작(造作)해 왔다.)

How lamentable is this? (이 얼마나 슬펀(*픈) 일인가.)

The constitution exists for the people, not for dictators. To prevent North Korea's communism, only liberal democracy can check communism. I clearly oppose two things: communism and dictatorship. Neither disregards human dignity, tramples on humanity, nor ignores human rights, preventing humans from living as humans. (헌법(憲法)은 국민(囗民)을 위해 있는 것이지 독재자(獨裁者)를 위해서 있어서는 안 된다. 북한(北韓)의 공산주의(共産主義)를 막기 위해서는 자유민주주의(自由民主主義)만이가 공산주의(共産主義)를 막을 수 있다. 나는 분명(分明)하게 두 가지를 반대(反對)한다. 공산주의(共産主義)와 독재주의(獨裁主義)를 반대(反對)한다. 이 어느 것도 인간(人間)의 존엄성(尊嚴性)을 무시(無視)하며 또 인간성(人間性)을 짓밟어(*으)며 인권(人權)을 무시(無視)하며 인간(人間)이 인간(人間)답게 살 수 없기 때문이다.)

I am not sure of the origin of when humans began crying out for freedom. Perhaps humans have thought about freedom since they came into existence. Even Jesus Christ being crucified 2,000 years ago was for freedom. (인간(人間)이 자유(自由)를 부러지진(*부르짖은)지가 언제부터인지 나는 그 기원을 잘 모르겠다. 아마도 인간(人間)이 세상(世上)에 생겨나면서부터 자유(自由)를 생각했던 것 아닌가 생각한다. 2000년전(年前)에 예수님이 십자가(十字架)에 못박혀 죽으시던 것도 자유(自由)를 위해서였다.)

The French Revolution and the American Civil War were the same. So many revolutions in the West. Amidst countless revolutions and counter-revolutions of revolution and agony, what was ultimately discovered was today's democracy. Revolutions defeat the opponent with guns and swords, but democracy allows free competition without completely destroying the opponent, giving them another chance. That is why they coexist. That is the most important truth. That is why they can endure each other. (불란스(*프랑스) 혁명(革命)도 미국(美囗) 남북전쟁(南北戰爭)도 마찬가지다. 서(西)구에서 그 많은 혁명(革命). 혁명(革命)에 또 반혁명(反革命) 그 헤아리기 어려운 혁명(革命)과 고(苦)통 가운데서 발견(發見)해 낸 것이 마주(*지)막에는 오늘의 민주주의(民主主義)였다. 혁명(革命)은 총과 칼로 상대방(相對方)을 무찌리기고(*무찌르고?) 말지마는 민주주의(民主主義)는 서로가 자유(自由)스럽게 경쟁(競爭)은 하지마는 완전(完全)히 상대방(方)을 멸망(亡)시키지는 않고 다음 기회(機会)가 주어지는 것이다. 그렇기 때문에 공존(共存)하는 것이다. 그것이 가장 중요(重要)한 진리(眞理)이다. 그러기 때문에 서로가 참을 수 있다.)

For 34 years, dictators have not completely deceived the people, though they may think they have. But now, because the people are exhausted, it seems the time has come to practice democracy. (우리들은 34년간(年間)이나 독재자(獨裁者)들이 국민(囗民)을 완전(完全)히 속이지는 못했지마는 그들은 국민(囗民)을 속였다고 생각하고 있겠지마는 이제는 지처서(*지쳤으)니까 민주주의(民主主義)를 해야할 때가 오고야 만 것 같으다.)

Thinking that today is Constitution Day, I reflect on the suffering public and myself. Even in the communist country of Poland, there was a news report that Wałęsa would be released from house arrest on the 22nd, their Independence Day. (오늘이 제헌절(制憲節)이라고 생각하니 고통 속에 있는 국민(囗民) 대중(大衆)을 생각해보며 내 자신(自身)도 생각해본다. 공산국가(共産國家) ‘포오란드(*폴란드)’의 “바엔사(*바웬사)”까지도 이번 22일(日) 그들의 독립기념일(獨立記念日)에는 연금에서 석방된다는 보도(報道)가 신문(新聞)에 있었다.)

I am now under house arrest without the people even knowing, and I have no idea when I might be released. (나는 과연(果然) 국민(囗民)들도 알지 못하게 지금 이렇게 연금되고 있는데 언제 석방이 될 수 있는 것인지 나는 전연(全然) 알지 못하고 있다.)

What have I lived for? (무엇을 위하여 살아왔는가?)

I don't think many people ponder what they are living for. (인간(人間)은 내가 무엇을 위하여 살아가고 있다는 생각을 하는 사람은 그렇게 많지 않다고 생각한다.)

If someone asks me what I have lived for... (나는 과연(果然) 무엇을 위하여 살아 왔느냐고 그 누구인가가 묻는다면……)

I could say, first, for love, and second, for the suffering and weak public. (첫째 사랑을 위하여 둘째 고통 당(当)하고 있는 약(弱)한 대중(大衆)을 위해서라고 말할 수 있을 것이다.)

Today is a clear autumn day among autumn days. Riding a bicycle in short exercise pants this morning, the weather is quite chilly. I feel very good this morning. (오늘은 맑은 가을날 중(中)의 가을 날씨다. 아침에 짧은 바지 운동복을 입고 자전거(自轉車)를 타니 날씨가 제복(*제법) 차다. 아침에는 기분(氣分)이 매우 좋다.)

Today is Sunday. I know that in churches scattered across every corner of the nation, many patriotic believers pray fervently for the country and its people. (오늘은 주일(主日)날이다. 전국(全囗)에 방방곡곡에 산재(散在)해 있는 교회(敎会)에서 그래도 나라를 사랑하는 많은 성도(聖徒)들이 나라와 겨레를 위하여 기도 많이 하는 날인줄 압니다.)

'Loving God the Father! We thank you, Father, for protecting us poor souls even in times of tribulation. Have mercy on this nation and its people, and grant us a day soon when this land becomes one with freedom, love, democracy, and guaranteed human rights. We earnestly pray that you grant a time for the wicked to repent quickly. Amen.' (‘사랑하시는 하나님 아버지! 불쌍한 우리들을 활난(*환난) 중(中)에도 지켜주심을 아버지께 감사(感謝)드립니다. 이 나라와 이 나라 백성(百姓)들을 불쌍히 보시옵고 자유(自由)와 사랑과 민주주의(民主主義)가 있어(*으)며 인권(人權)이 보장되는 나라가 하로(*하루) 속히 되는 때를 주시옵소서. 악(惡)의 무리들이 하로 속히 희게(*회개)하는 때를 주시옵기를 간절히 원하옵니다. 아멘’)

Gyeongmi came by. I can't go, but she went to Chunghyun Church with the family, had lunch, and left. In the afternoon, I feel a bit under the weather with cold symptoms. (경미(敬美)가 와서 나는 못가지마는 가족(家族)들과 함께 충(忠)현교회(敎会)에 갔다가 와서 점심을 먹고 갔다. 오후(午后)에는 감기 기운이 있으면서 기분(氣分)이 약간 좋지를 않다.)

Today is a very clear day. It is truly an autumn sky. I received a phone call from Director Kim, who said he feels frustrated every Thursday. I suppose it's because he thinks of the hikes we used to take together every Thursday. On a day like this, I too want to go hiking. (오늘은 아주 맑은 날이다. 천성(*천상) 가을 하늘이다. 김실장(金室長)으로부터 목요일(木曜日)만 되면 분하다고 하며 전화(電話)가 왔다. 목요일(木曜日)마다 같이 등산(登山) 가던 생각에서 일 것이다. 오늘 같이 좋은 날씨에는 나도 등산(登山) 가구 싶다.)

But I must endure. Enduring tribulation builds patience. Patience also requires courage. (그러나 참아야 한다. 활난(*환난)을 당(当)하면 참을성이 생긴다. 참는 것도 용기(勇氣)가 있으(*어)야 한다.)

Yesterday, in Lebanon, "Gemayel," who had been newly elected president and was to be inaugurated on the 21st, was at his party headquarters celebrating with supporters when a bomb planted by opponents exploded, causing the building to collapse. He died along with 40 or 50 of his associates in the blast. He had been forcibly elected president under gunpoint by the National Assembly when Israel invaded Lebanon. It is difficult to predict how the Middle East situation will change. (어제는 “레바논”에서 새로 대통령(大統領)에 당선(當選)되어 오는 21일(日)에 새로 취임(就任)하는 “게마엘”이 자기(自己) 당사(党舍)에서 지지자(支持者)들과 축하(祝賀)의 모임을 하는 도중(途中)에 반대자(反對者)들이 부설한 폭탄에 위(*의)해서 당사(党舍)가 폭발하는 바람에 40 혹(或)은 50명(名)의 동(同)조자(者)들과 함께 폭사(爆死)해서 죽는 사건(事件)이 생겼다. 이스라엘이 레바논에 진입(進入)했을 적에 국회(囗会)에서 강제(强制)로 총으로 대통령(大統領)에 당선(當選) 시켰었다. 앞으로 중동사태(中東事態)가 어떻게 달라질러는지 예(豫)칙(*측)하기가 어렵다.)

Also yesterday, Princess Grace of Monaco died in a car accident. And just a few days ago, Ingrid Bergman passed away... (또한 어제는 “모낙코(*모나코)” 왕비(王妃)인 “그레스 케리”가 자동차(自動車) 사고(事故)로 죽었다. 요 몇일 전(前)에는 “인그란드(*잉그리드) 버그만”이 죽더니……)

Princess Grace was a woman as beautiful as a movie and lived a happy life. I think a beautiful woman lived her life beautifully and then died. All humans die. But especially those who hold power forget that they themselves will die before long. If they remembered that they would die, they would not engage in such dictatorial politics that inflict suffering on everyone. (“그레스 케리”는 영화처럼 아릅답고 행복(幸福)한 여자(女子)였다. 아름다운 여자(女子)가 인생(人生)을 아름답게 살다가 죽었다고 생각한다. 인간(人間)은 누구나가 죽는 것이다. 그런데 특(特)히 권력(權力)을 잡은 자(者)들은 자기(自己)가 얼마 가지 않이(*아니) 해서 죽는다는 사실(事実)을 잊어버린다. 죽는다는 사실을 기억한다면 이러한 만인(萬人)에게 고통을 주는 독재정치(獨裁政治)는 아니할 것이기 때문이다.)

item.title: US Defense Secretary Mentions Iran Operation in Front of Ahn Gyu-baek… “Hope Allies Stand Shoulder to Shoulder with Us” (美국방, 안규백 앞 이란 작전 언급… “동맹이 우리와 어깨 나란히 하길”)
item.description:
US Defense Secretary Mentions Iran Operation in Front of Ahn Gyu-baek… “Hope Allies Stand Shoulder to Shoulder with Us” (美국방, 안규백 앞 이란 작전 언급… “동맹이 우리와 어깨 나란히 하길”)

U.S. Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth, at a South Korea-U.S. defense ministerial meeting held at the Pentagon on the 11th, stated that President Donald Trump's military operation against Iran, "Epic Fury," "demonstrates a firm resolve to confront threats and defend key national security interests." He added, "In the current global environment, the resilience of our alliances is critical, and we expect partner nations to stand shoulder to shoulder with us and work together." Trump previously requested allied nations to deploy forces to secure freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz, and specifically pointed to South Korea on multiple occasions, expressing dissatisfaction that "the U.S. has troops stationed there, yet they do not help us." <<> In his opening remarks that day, Hegseth said, "This meeting comes at a pivotal moment for the ROK-U.S. alliance" and "both nations are taking strong measures to solidify joint combat readiness and defend key national security interests." This meeting was held six months after the Seoul Security Consultative Meeting (SCM) in November of last year. South Korea and the U.S. are currently engaged in discussions on "alliance modernization," focusing on reassessing the role and responsibilities of U.S. Forces Korea and increasing South Korea's defense spending. Hegseth noted, "South Korea's commitment to increasing defense spending and Minister Ahn's leadership in assuming primary responsibility for security on the Korean Peninsula are very important," calling it "an example of alliance burden-sharing that all U.S. partner nations should emulate." <<> In a joint press statement summarizing the results of the day's meeting, South Korea and the U.S. reported that Hegseth "emphasized the importance of adopting a realistic and practical approach to deter threats and strengthen the ROK-U.S. combined defense posture while modernizing the alliance." Minister Ahn outlined South Korea's recent efforts to increase defense spending, secure core military capabilities, and take the lead in defending the Korean Peninsula. The two sides discussed major issues such as the transition of wartime operational control (OPCON) and agreed to strengthen future cooperation. While the Lee Jae-myung administration aims to reclaim OPCON during its term, the U.S. side does not deny the overarching goal of OPCON transition but maintains that focusing on 'conditions-based' approach rather than a timeline is necessary to avoid undermining the alliance's deterrence. Securing core military capabilities, the ability to respond to North Korean threats, and the security environment are the three key conditions for OPCON transition agreed upon by South Korea and the U.S. (피트 헤그세스 미 전쟁부(국방부) 장관은 11일 펜타곤 청사에서 열린 한미 국방장관 회담에서 도널드 트럼프 대통령의 대(對)이란 군사 작전인 ‘장대한 분노(Epic Fury)’가 “위협에 맞서고 핵심적인 국가 안보 이익을 수호하겠다는 확고한 의지를 보여주는 것”이라며 “현재의 글로벌 환경에서 우리 동맹의 강인함은 매우 중요하고, 우리는 파트너 국가들이 우리와 어깨를 나란히 하고 함께해주기를 기대한다”고 했다. 트럼프는 앞서 우방에 호르무즈 해협 항행 자유 확보를 위한 파병을 요청했고, 한국을 콕 집어 ‘미군이 주둔하고 있는데 우리를 도와주지 않는다’는 취지로 여러 차례 불만을 드러낸 적이 있다.)

item.title: "National Assembly Speaker is Rep. Cho Jung-sik"... Controversy over President Lee Sharing Supporter's Post on X (“국회의장은 조정식”… 李대통령, X에 지지자 글 공유 논란)
item.description:
"National Assembly Speaker is Rep. Cho Jung-sik"... Controversy over President Lee Sharing Supporter's Post on X (“국회의장은 조정식”… 李대통령, X에 지지자 글 공유 논란)

On the 11th, President Lee Jae-myung shared a post on X (formerly Twitter) from a supporter who certified their vote for Rep. Cho Jung-sik of the Democratic Party of Korea in the election for the Speaker of the 22nd National Assembly's second half, while explaining the preferential voting system. The People Power Party criticized it as "blatant interference in party affairs by intervening in the National Assembly Speaker election." The election for the Speaker, a three-way race involving Rep. Cho and five-term lawmakers Kim Tae-nyeon and Park Ji-won, will determine the final candidate on the 13th by combining votes from party members (20%) and incumbent lawmakers (80%). <<> President Lee stated, "The preferential voting system was introduced alongside the runoff voting system when I was the Democratic Party leader," adding, "It's a method to preliminarily conduct a runoff in the first round, eliminating the need for a second runoff when the top candidate in the first round fails to secure a majority." He continued, "Please be aware that if you don’t select a second choice, you effectively abstain in the runoff when your first-choice candidate is eliminated. Do not misunderstand, and be sure to select both your first and second preferences." <<> He then shared a supporter's post certifying that they had chosen Rep. Cho Jung-sik as their top pick for National Assembly Speaker. The supporter wrote, "The National Assembly Speaker is Rep. Cho Jung-sik. I can't understand why rankings are necessary," adding, "There’s only one person to vote for, so why bother ranking?" This appeared to explain the purpose of the preferential voting system, which requires selecting a second choice, to a supporter who claimed there were no other candidates to vote for besides Rep. Cho. President Lee posted this on X about two hours before the deadline for party member voting. <<> Even within the Democratic Party, there were remarks that President Lee’s sharing of a post mentioning pro-Lee faction Rep. Cho, with the National Assembly Speaker election imminent, was inappropriate. In response, a first-term Democratic lawmaker said, "There was already gossip when President Lee appointed Rep. Cho as a senior presidential secretary for political affairs last year," adding, "It’s not right from the perspective of the separation of powers for the president to seem to support a candidate for the National Assembly Speaker, a position that should maintain political neutrality." Within the party, it had previously been said that "President Lee's intent lies with Rep. Cho." Six-term Rep. Cho is considered a core pro-Lee figure who served as Secretary-General when President Lee was party leader. Earlier, on the 3rd, President Lee posted on X when Rep. Cho resigned as senior presidential secretary for political affairs to run for National Assembly Speaker, saying, "You have always been with me, and I sincerely thank you." Amid the controversy, the Presidential Office issued a statement that day, saying, "This is merely an explanation of the preferential voting system, and is not related to any specific candidate." (이재명 대통령이 11일 X(옛 트위터)에 선호투표제 취지를 설명하며 22대 후반기 국회의장 선거에서 조정식 더불어민주당 의원에게 투표 인증을 한 지지자의 글을 공유했다. 국민의힘은 “국회의장 선거 개입에 노골적인 당무 개입”이라고 했다. 조 의원과 5선 김태년·박지원 의원의 3파전으로 치러지는 국회의장 선거는 권리당원(20%)과 현역 국회의원(80%) 투표를 합산해 오는 13일 최종 후보를 결정한다.)

item.title: A Week After the Attack... Blue House: "Strongly Condemn" (피격 일주일 지난 뒤… 靑 “강력 규탄”)
item.description:
A Week After the Attack... Blue House: "Strongly Condemn" (피격 일주일 지난 뒤… 靑 “강력 규탄”)

On the 11th, the Blue House issued a statement regarding the 'NAMU', a multipurpose carrier owned by HMM (formerly Hyundai Merchant Marine), the nation's largest shipping company, which was attacked while anchored in the Strait of Hormuz, saying, "We firmly condemn this as attacks on civilian vessels cannot be justified or tolerated." National Security Director Chung Eui-yong of the Blue House stated in a briefing that day, "Two unidentified aircraft struck the stern plating of the NAMU twice at approximately one-minute intervals." (청와대가 호르무즈 해협 정박 중 피격된 국내 최대 해운사 HMM(옛 현대상선)의 다목적 운반선 ‘나무(NAMU)호’와 관련해 11일 “민간 선박에 대한 공격은 정당화되거나 용납될 수 없다는 입장으로서 이를 강력히 규탄한다”고 밝혔다. 위성락 청와대 국가안보실장은 이날 브리핑에서 “미상의 비행체 2기가 나무호 선미 외판을 약 1분 간격으로 2차례 타격했다”며 이같이 말했다.)

According to shipping industry sources and government officials, HMM notified the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries on the 4th, the day of the attack, about the NAMU's situation, stating, "A fire broke out in the left side of the engine room due to an external impact." The initial report shared within the government by the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries also noted that it was "suspected to be an attack on a national cargo ship." U.S. President Donald Trump also claimed that "Iran fired it." Nevertheless, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs initially said, "There was an explosion and fire" on the NAMU, while the Blue House referred to it as a "ship fire" and said "it needs to be investigated," before belatedly acknowledging the attack. <<> Regarding this, a senior Blue House official said that while there were initial reports of an external impact, "There were also other claims denying the attack theory, so we thought it best to reserve judgment on whether it was an attack or not." This suggests that the Blue House chose to describe it only as a "fire." The attack created a hole about 5 meters wide in the stern of the NAMU, but the Blue House also stated, "We did not initially receive a report that there was a breach." <<> Even while expressing condemnation a week after the attack, the Blue House said, "We are not specifying the entity behind the attack." A senior Blue House official commented, "Whether Iran is involved is currently an unknown area," adding, "We are considering the possibilities of various countries." When asked, "If the responsible country is identified, what level of response will be taken?" the official replied, "It is difficult to say that we have any preconceptions or are making any advance determinations about what measures to take." <<> Experts believe that although there were circumstances suggesting an attack from the early stages of the incident, the government maintained ambiguity considering its relations with the U.S. and Iran. Acknowledging the attack could increase U.S. pressure for troop deployment near Hormuz and negatively impact relations with Iran. <<> ◇All Circumstances Pointed to an 'Attack,' but the Government Continued to Say 'Investigation Needed' <<> On the 4th, when the NAMU was attacked while anchored off the coast of Umm Al Quwain in the United Arab Emirates (UAE), Iran resumed drone and missile attacks on the UAE for the first time since its ceasefire with the U.S. last month. On the same day, an oil tanker owned by a Chinese company was also attacked near Mina Saqr in the UAE, causing a fire on its deck. <<> In response, the Chinese Foreign Ministry stated in a briefing on the 7th, when asked about "how they view oil tankers trying to pass through the Strait of Hormuz being attacked by Iran," that they "firmly oppose actions that escalate tensions" and that "civilians and non-military targets must be protected." On the 8th, they more directly acknowledged the attack, stating that "Chinese national crew members were on board the relevant vessel that was attacked." <<> Our government released a message of condemnation only on the 11th, a week after the attack. Even on that day, Foreign Minister Cho Tae-yul said, "We need to cautiously assess some remaining details before making a judgment." A senior Blue House official also said, "It is difficult to say that we have any preconceptions or are making advance determinations about the entity behind the attack." This appears to be a strategy of maintaining "strategic ambiguity" out of concern for diplomatic repercussions, but some criticize it as excessive caution. <<> A former high-ranking government official said, "China already acknowledged the attack and issued a position indirectly criticizing Iran, wrapping up the issue. By around the 8th, when the NAMU was towed to Dubai, it would have been visually possible to confirm the attack, so one cannot help but feel that our government's announcement was late." <<> On the day of the attack, the 4th, crew members of the NAMU reportedly heard a "bang" sound from an explosion. HMM also notified the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries that a fire had occurred due to an "external impact." U.S. President Donald Trump immediately pointed to an Iranian attack as the cause. <<> Nevertheless, the Blue House described the NAMU's situation as a "ship fire" on the day of the attack and the following day, and even on the third day, the 6th, they said, "The attack is not that certain." Even on the 8th and 9th, when the NAMU was towed to Dubai and the submerged damaged parts became visible, the government did not release a statement regarding the possibility of an attack. Initially, some figures in the government and the ruling party even expressed doubt in private settings, suggesting that "the shipping company might claim an external impact because the insurance payout would be larger than for a ship fire." <<> On this day, a senior Blue House official said, "Some people on the ship might have thought it was an attack, but they were in a situation where they couldn't see outside the vessel," adding that the decision to reserve judgment on an attack was made because "if we had made a wrong judgment, there could be consequences." Regarding President Trump's claim of an "Iranian attack," this official commented, "No one from the U.S. side has clearly explained the basis for President Trump's statement." While security camera (CCTV) footage of the NAMU's stern captured the incoming aircraft, the Blue House said, "We identified that a bit late." This was because it took time for the independent Korea Maritime Safety Tribunal to analyze the NAMU's CCTV footage and report it to the Blue House. <<> Experts believe the government could not rush to announce an attack due to considerations regarding relations with the U.S. and Iran. Acknowledging an Iranian attack could strengthen President Trump's demands for troop deployment near Hormuz and cloud future relations with Iran, with which South Korea has had significant trade in the past. Iran's cooperation may also be necessary for the safety of the 26 South Korean ships still in the Strait of Hormuz. Professor Park Hyun-do of Sogang University said, "The moment Iran is specified as the attacking entity, U.S. pressure for troop deployment will intensify, and there's no reason to unnecessarily get involved in America's war." President Park In-hwi of Ewha Womans University's Graduate School of International Studies stated, "As the U.S.-Iran conflict approaches its conclusion, our government may be in an awkward position to make specific actions." <<> A senior Blue House official, when asked on this day whether "the attack on the NAMU has led to a more advanced stance on the 'Maritime Freedom Initiative,' which is the U.S. proposal to form a multinational security coalition," replied, "I don't think it's directly linked to that extent." He added that while "we are willing to provide all necessary cooperation for international efforts to ensure stability and free navigation in the strait," it does not mean an immediate decision is being made. (해운업계와 정부 관계자 등에 따르면 HMM은 피격 당일인 지난 4일 해양수산부에 “외부 충격에 의한 기관실 좌측 화재 발생”이라고 나무호 상황을 알렸다. 해수부가 정부 내에 공유한 최초 보고도 “국적 화물선 피격 추정”이었다. 도널드 트럼프 미 대통령도 “이란이 쐈다”고 했다. 그럼에도 외교부는 나무호에서 “폭발·화재가 발생했다”, 청와대는 “선박 화재”가 있었다며 “조사해 봐야 한다”고만 하다가 결국 뒤늦게 피격을 인정한 것이다.)

item.title: Ha Jung-woo: "Park and Han are from the prosecution... I'm the one who will become one team with the president and the party" (하정우 “朴·韓 검찰 출신… 난 당청과 원팀 될 인물”)
item.description:
Ha Jung-woo: "Park and Han are from the prosecution... I'm the one who will become one team with the president and the party" (하정우 “朴·韓 검찰 출신… 난 당청과 원팀 될 인물”)

"I'll work even harder than 'Brother Jae-soo' (Jeon Jae-soo, Busan mayoral candidate)." On Parents' Day, May 8, at the Mandeok Community Welfare Center in Buk-gu, Busan. Ha Jung-woo, a candidate for the by-election for the Buk-gu Gap National Assembly seat, made this remark while meeting the eyes of elderly people seated on chairs. When one elderly person said, "You're too young," Candidate Ha smiled and replied, "Being young means I can work even harder!" At the campaign office opening ceremony on May 10, he also introduced himself as "a child who grew up watching my mother's street stall at Busan's Deokpo Market, a middle school student who studied while dreaming of the future at Deokcheon-dong's academy district," and added, "Everyone here is my mother and father." <<> Until recently, 'HaGPT' (Candidate Ha's nickname), who reported AI (artificial intelligence) strategies to President Lee Jae-myung in a suit at the presidential office, was meeting voters using the Busan dialect. Candidate Ha said, "Until recently, I mainly showed a rigid image as a presidential staffer serving as the Senior Secretary for AI Future Planning, but saying 'brother, mother' is my true self." <<> In an interview with this newspaper on May 11, Candidate Ha stated, "People Power Party candidate Park Min-sik and independent candidate Han Dong-hoon, both former prosecutors, are 'past-tense candidates,'" adding, "If I am elected, I will take responsibility for Buk-gu's future as 'one team' with President Lee Jae-myung and the Democratic Party." Candidate Ha said, "Both are capable individuals who have served as ministers," but noted, "Candidate Park is suspected of deleting Facebook posts related to former President Yoon Seok-yeol, and Candidate Han remains stuck in the past by appointing someone who was a prosecutor during the Chun Doo-hwan regime as his campaign chairman. What Buk-gu needs now is not a past-tense figure but someone who can take responsibility for its future." <<> He said, "Buk-gu currently faces a mountain of issues to resolve, including a shortage of youth jobs, care gaps due to an aging population, and problems with transportation and education infrastructure," adding, "Candidate Jeon Jae-soo has fought hard as the area's National Assembly member. Now, once I'm elected, I will move together with the central government as one team to solve these problems." He also pledged to create a successful case of "physical AI-based industrial transformation" in Buk-gu, saying, "As an AI expert, I will hit the ground and unblock the clogged points." <<> In recent opinion polls, Candidate Ha is ranking first. However, he hasn't surpassed the 40% threshold. Candidate Ha said, "This might be due to the late start of my campaign," and vowed to work harder to make his name known by visiting the region more frequently. Regarding the possibility of a merger between candidates Park Min-sik and Han Dong-hoon, he said, "From the perspective of Buk-gu's development, I question what effect such an opposition alliance would have." On the controversies raised during his campaign, including "shaking off his hand after a handshake" and "demanding to be called 'oppa,'" Candidate Ha said, "As a political novice, I had some immature moments in adapting to the field. I apologize once again." (“‘재수 행님(전재수 부산시장 후보)’ 이상으로 열심히 하겠습니더.” 어버이날인 지난 8일, 부산 북구 만덕종합사회복지관. 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거에 출마한 하정우 후보가 의자에 앉은 어르신들과 눈을 맞추며 이렇게 말했다. 한 어르신이 “너무 젊다”고 하자 하 후보는 “젊으니까 더 열심히 할 수 있지예~”라며 웃었다. 하 후보는 10일 선거 사무소 개소식에서도 자신을 “부산 덕포시장에서 어머니의 좌판을 보며 자란 아(아이), 덕천동 학원가에서 미래를 꿈꾸면서 공부했던 중학생”이라고 소개하며 “여기 와 계신 모든 분들이 제 어무이, 아부집니더”라고 했다.)

item.title: Han Dong-hoon: “If the indictment is withdrawn, it would be grounds for impeachment… If I win, Lee will be hurt.” (한동훈 “공소 취소땐 탄핵감… 내가 이겨야 李 아플 것”)
item.description:
Han Dong-hoon: “If the indictment is withdrawn, it would be grounds for impeachment… If I win, Lee will be hurt.” (한동훈 “공소 취소땐 탄핵감… 내가 이겨야 李 아플 것”)

At 9 p.m. on the 10th, on ‘Youth Street’ in front of Deokcheon Station in Busan. Independent candidate Han Dong-hoon, running in the by-election for the National Assembly seat in Buk-gu District 1, Busan, took to the streets for a Sunday campaign rally. During the 40-minute walk, about 30 groups of students, couples, and shopkeepers approached the candidate to shake his hand. Han said, “Although I was expelled from the People Power Party and am running as an independent, please support me strongly,” and “Help me change the country.” A middle-aged man leaned in close to Han and whispered, “I’m a member of another party, so I can’t openly support you, but I’m cheering you on.” (10일 저녁 9시 부산 덕천역 앞 ‘젊음의 거리’. 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거에 출마한 무소속 한동훈 후보가 일요일 거리 유세를 나섰다. 40여 분을 걷는 동안 학생, 연인, 상인 등 30여 팀이 한 후보에게 다가와 악수를 청했다. 한 후보는 “(국민의힘에서) 제명당해 무소속이지만, 꼭 지지해 달라” “나라를 바꿀 수 있게 도와달라”고 했다. 한 중년 남성은 한 후보에게 바짝 다가서더니 작은 목소리로 말했다. “내가 다른 당 당원이라 대놓고 지지는 못 해도 응원합니다.”)

Before the street rally, Han met at a café in Gupo Market and said, “Over the past 20 years with (former lawmakers) Park Min-shik and Jeon Jae-soo, Buk-gu District 1 has always been last in development among the 18 districts in Busan,” adding, “I’ll make sure people and money flow back to this place, which has become like an isolated island within Busan.” He pledged to establish a complex arena for performances, exhibitions, and sports. Han remarked, “In pro baseball, the last-place team gets the first draft pick the next year, but Buk-gu District 1 has always been last in the draft too,” and “Now it’s time for Buk-gu District 1 to confidently demand the first pick.” (거리 유세에 앞서 구포시장의 한 카페에서 만난 한 후보는 “(역대 국회의원이었던) 박민식·전재수 20년 동안 북갑은 18개 부산 지역구 중 늘 발전의 후순위였다”며 “부산 내 외딴섬처럼 된 이곳에 사람과 돈이 돌게 하겠다”고 했다. 그는 공연·전시·스포츠 복합 아레나 설립을 공약했다. 한 후보는 “프로야구 꼴찌 팀이 다음 해 드래프트 1순위를 받는데, 북갑은 드래프트도 후순위였다”며 “이제는 북갑이 1순위를 당당히 요구할 때가 됐다”고 했다.)

In a three-way race against Democratic Party candidate Ha Jung-woo and People Power Party candidate Park Min-shik, Han said, “I have a chance to win.” He added, “Residents seem to see me as a potential presidential contender and hope that the region and I can grow and develop together.” Regarding his opponents, he said, “Candidate Ha is like Procrustes’ bed—trying to fit Buk-gu District 1 into his specialty, AI,” and “As for Candidate Park, who claims to be a true Buk-gu resident, I’d like to ask what he did for regional development during his time as a lawmaker.” (한 후보는 더불어민주당 하정우, 국민의힘 박민식 후보와의 3자 대결 구도에서 “내가 승산이 있다”고 했다. 그는 “주민께선 나를 잠재적 대권 주자로 보고 지역과 내가 함께 성장·발전하길 바라시는 것 같다”고 했다. 상대 후보들에 대해선 “하 후보는 ‘프로크루스테스의 침대’처럼 자기 전공인 AI(인공 지능)에 북갑을 끼워 맞춘다”며 “진짜 북갑 주민이라는 박 후보는 의원 시절 지역 발전에 어떤 일을 했나 묻고 싶다”고 했다.)

On calls for a conservative candidate unity, Han stated, “In politics, there’s no absolute zero, and we need to be flexible,” adding, “Saying ‘absolutely zero’ (like Candidate Park Min-shik) indicates fear (of being at a disadvantage).” However, Han noted, “Right now, the priority is not unity but developing Buk-gu, checking the government, and rebuilding conservatism.” (한 후보는 보수 후보 단일화 요구에 대해선 “정치에서 0은 없고, 유연해야 한다”며 “(박민식 후보처럼) ‘절대 0이다’라고 하는 것은 (자기가 불리하다는) 두려움이 있는 것”이라고 했다. 다만, 한 후보는 “지금 우선 순위는 단일화보다 북구 발전, 정권 견제, 보수 재건”이라고 했다.)

Regarding the Democratic Party’s push for a special counsel law on “fabricated indictments” that could withdraw the indictment in the case of President Lee Jae-myung, Han said, “If the indictment in President Lee Jae-myung’s case is withdrawn, it would be grounds for impeachment,” and “I’ll go out on the streets with the people to impeach.” He also said, “My victory is what would hurt the Lee Jae-myung government the most.” (민주당이 이재명 대통령 사건을 공소 취소할 수 있는 ‘조작 기소’ 특검법을 추진한 데 대해 한 후보는 “이재명 대통령 사건이 공소 취소가 되면 탄핵감”이라며 “국민과 거리에 나가 탄핵하겠다”고 했다. “내가 승리하는 게 이재명 정부가 가장 아플 것”이라고도 했다.)

Since coming to Buk-gu, Han met victims of the Brothers Welfare Center who haven’t received compensation due to budget shortages, and residents complaining, “We live in apartments built by the Urban Development Corporation, but for 10 years, they haven’t mowed the grass in the complex.” Han said, “I want to address these urgent demands first.” “Isn’t politics about giving back when you’ve received the residents’ generosity?” (한 후보는 북구에 온 이후 예산 부족으로 보상금을 못 받은 형제복지원 피해자, “도시개발공사가 지은 아파트에 사는데 10년째 단지 내 풀을 안 깎아준다”고 하소연하는 주민을 만났다. 한 후보는 “절실한 요구를 맨 먼저 해결하고 싶다”고 했다. “주민의 베풂은 받았으면 돌려드리는 게 정치 아닙니까.”)

item.title: Kim Gwan-young Leads Lee Won-taek Within Margin of Error... Ruling Party Leadership on High Alert (김관영, 이원택에 오차범위 내 우세… 與 지도부 초비상)
item.description:
Kim Gwan-young Leads Lee Won-taek Within Margin of Error... Ruling Party Leadership on High Alert (김관영, 이원택에 오차범위 내 우세… 與 지도부 초비상)

A poll released on the 11th showed Jeonbuk Governor Kim Gwan-young, who was expelled from the Democratic Party over allegations of proxy payment and declared his candidacy as an independent, leading Democratic Party candidate Lee Won-taek within the margin of error. The Democratic Party leadership is on edge. Within the party, there are comments such as, "It's unthinkable to lose our stronghold when the president's approval rating is very high," and "The Jeonbuk election results will significantly affect whether Representative Jeong Cheong-rae can win a second term as party leader in August." (‘대리비 지급 의혹’으로 민주당에서 제명된 뒤 무소속 출마를 선언한 김관영 전북지사가 민주당 이원택 후보를 오차 범위 내에서 앞선다는 여론 조사 결과가 11일 나왔다. 민주당 지도부는 비상이 걸렸다. 당내에선 “대통령 지지율이 매우 높은 상황에서 텃밭을 뺏긴다는 건 있을 수 없는 일”이라며 “전북 선거 결과가 정청래 대표의 8월 당대표 연임 여부에 상당한 영향을 끼칠 것”이란 말이 나왔다.)

In a survey conducted by JoWon C&I on the 9th and 10th at the request of News1's Jeonbuk bureau (wireless ARS, targeting 1,000 voters in the region), Governor Kim Gwan-young received 43.2% support, while candidate Lee Won-taek got 39.7%. Among Democratic Party supporters, 46.8% chose Lee, while 41.4% picked Governor Kim. The once-safe stronghold of Jeonbuk has become a battleground. Governor Kim's side stated in a commentary, "The public's judgment of the Jeong Cheong-rae leadership has begun." (뉴스1 전북취재본부 의뢰로 조원씨앤아이가 9~10일 이 지역 유권자 1000명을 대상으로 실시한 여론조사(무선 ARS)에서 김관영 지사는 43.2%, 이원택 후보는 39.7%였다. 민주당 지지자 46.8%는 이 후보를, 41.4%는 김 지사를 택했다. 텃밭인 전북이 격전지가 된 것이다. 김 지사 측은 논평에서 “정청래 지도부에 대한 민심의 심판이 시작됐다”고 했다.)

The Democratic Party appeared clearly flustered. Han Byeong-do, the Democratic Party's floor leader and a three-term lawmaker representing Iksan-eul in Jeonbuk, canceled his attendance at a party leadership event in Chuncheon, Gangwon, on the same day and urgently returned to Jeonbuk. At a press conference in the provincial council, Floor Leader Han supported candidate Lee Won-taek, saying, "Jeonbuk's development is only possible if the Democratic Party candidate, as the ruling party, wins the election." The previous day, Secretary-General Jo Seung-rae, targeting Kim's independent bid, declared, "Permanent re-entry into the party is forbidden." This hardline stance is believed to have been taken after assessing that public sentiment in Jeonbuk was unstable. <<> In the local political scene, some are saying, "This is the aftermath of forcing the nomination of Lee Won-taek, a pro-Jeong Cheong-rae candidate." Earlier, the Jeong Cheong-rae leadership urgently expelled Governor Kim on the day the proxy payment allegations surfaced. Meanwhile, in the case of candidate Lee's alleged meal payment proxy scheme, the party concluded, "No charges were found." Ahn Ho-young, a former candidate for the Jeonbuk governor primary, went on a hunger strike demanding a reinvestigation, but his request was rejected. (민주당은 당황한 기색이 역력했다. 전북 익산을의 3선 의원인 한병도 민주당 원내대표는 이날 강원 춘천 지도부 일정 참석을 취소하고 긴급하게 전북으로 내려갔다. 한 원내대표는 도의회 기자간담회에서 “전북 발전은 집권당인 민주당 후보가 당선이 돼야만 가능한 일”이라며 이원택 후보를 지원했다. 전날 조승래 사무총장이 김 지사의 무소속 출마를 겨냥해 “복당을 영구 불허한다”고 했는데 전북 민심이 심상치 않다는 판단에서 강경 대응을 한 것으로 알려졌다.)

The ruling camp believes the Jeonbuk election results will impact the Democratic Party's leadership election in August. A Democratic Party official said, "With Representative Jeong Cheong-rae's bid for re-election all but certain, if the party loses its stronghold, the issue of Jeong's responsibility will rise to the forefront," adding, "From Jeong's perspective, this local election has added the burden of not only securing battlegrounds but also protecting the party's stronghold." (지역 정가에선 “무리하게 친정청래계 이원택 후보를 공천한 후과”라는 말이 나온다. 앞서 정청래 지도부는 김 지사의 ‘대리비 지급 의혹’ 보도 당일 김 지사를 긴급 제명했다. 반면 이 후보의 ‘식사비 대납 의혹’에는 “혐의가 없다”는 결론을 냈다. 전북지사 경선 후보였던 안호영 의원이 단식하며 재감찰을 요구했지만 받아들이지 않았다.)

item.title: President Lee: “Predatory financial practices are tightening the noose on ordinary people’s livelihoods” (李대통령 “원시적 약탈금융, 서민 목줄 죄어”)
item.description:
President Lee: “Predatory financial practices are tightening the noose on ordinary people’s livelihoods” (李대통령 “원시적 약탈금융, 서민 목줄 죄어”)

On the 12th, President Lee Jae-myung criticized the private bad bank for not participating in the government’s “debt relief for ordinary people” policy, causing related debtors to suffer, stating, “I didn’t realize such primitive predatory finance was still thriving, tightening the noose on the necks of ordinary citizens.” (이재명 대통령은 12일 민간 배드뱅크가 정부의 ‘서민 빚 탕감’ 정책에 참여하지 않아 관련 채무자들이 피해를 보고 있다는 지적에 “아직도 이런 원시적 약탈 금융이 버젓이 살아남아 서민들 목줄을 죄고 있는 줄 몰랐다”고 했다.)

President Lee shared a related article on X (formerly Twitter) and said, “I sincerely thank you for the report,” adding, “Why have the authorities failed to even detect such an injustice until now?” He further said, “I will seek a solution at today’s cabinet meeting.” (이 대통령은 X(엑스·옛 트위터)에 관련 기사를 링크한 뒤 “보도에 진심으로 감사드린다”면서 이같이 밝혔다. 이 대통령은 “지금까지 관할 당국은 왜 이런 부조리를 발견조차 못 하고 있었을까”라며 “오늘 국무회의에서 해결 방안을 찾아보겠다”고 했다.)

He continued, “There is a limit to economic activities or corporate profit-making,” and “No matter how much money is supreme, our neighbors in the same community must live together—excess is as bad as deficiency.” (그러면서 “경제 활동이나 기업의 수익 활동에도 정도가 있는 것”이라며 “아무리 돈이 최고라지만, 함께 살아가야 할 공동체 안의 우리 이웃인데 과유불급”이라고 했다.)

The article President Lee linked to pointed out that the private bad bank “Sangnoksu,” a distressed debt processing company, has not participated in the New Leap Fund—a government policy to clear small overdue debts to help debtors who have lost repayment capacity—leaving related debtors without debt relief benefits. (이 대통령이 링크한 기사에는 상환 능력을 상실한 연체자를 돕기 위해 소액 연체 채권을 정리해 주는 정부 정책인 새도약기금에 부실 채권 처리 회사인 민간 배드뱅크 ‘상록수’는 참여하지 않아 관련 채무자들이 빚 탕감 혜택을 보지 못하고 있다는 지적이 담겼다.)

This bad bank is a special-purpose corporation established by major domestic banks and card companies, and the article also noted that each company has received dividends totaling approximately 42 billion won over the past five years. (이 배드뱅크는 국내 대형 은행·카드사들이 설립한 특수 목적 법인으로, 각 회사가 최근 5년간 420억원가량의 배당을 받았다는 내용도 함께 지적됐다.)

item.title: Park Min-shik: "Conservative unity under Number 2... No free ride for Ha Jung-woo" (박민식 “2번으로 보수 결집… 하정우 어부지리 없다”)
item.description:
Park Min-shik: "Conservative unity under Number 2... No free ride for Ha Jung-woo" (박민식 “2번으로 보수 결집… 하정우 어부지리 없다”)

On the morning of the 10th, meeting in front of the Mangdeok Catholic Church in Mangdeok-dong, Buk-gu, Busan, People Power Party candidate Park Min-shik was repeatedly bowing at a 90-degree angle to greet people. When a citizen who recognized him—running in the Buk-gu Gap by-election for the National Assembly—said, "You should win this time," Candidate Park replied in the local dialect, "I'll give it my all. Just give me a shot." (10일 오전 부산 북구 만덕동 천주교만덕성당 앞에서 만난 국민의힘 박민식 후보는 연신 90도로 허리를 숙여 인사를 하고 있었다. 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거에 출마한 그를 알아 본 한 시민이 “이번엔 돼야 할낀데”라고 하자 박 후보는 “단디 할끼예. 한 번 붙여주시소”라고 했다.)

Candidate Park has served as a lawmaker for this district twice, but lost in the 20th and 21st general elections to Democratic Party candidate Jeon Jae-soo. He said, "I've heard it said that while Jeon Jae-soo isn't great at his job but excels at personal contact, Park Min-shik does an outstanding job but lacks that touch. So now, I'm bowing low to approach residents and greet each person individually." One resident stopped his car, rolled down the window, and said, "Still, shouldn't we pick someone from Buk-gu?" (박 후보는 이 지역에서 두 차례 국회의원을 지냈지만 20·21대 총선에선 더불어민주당 소속 전재수 후보에게 내리 패했다. 박 후보는 “전재수 후보는 일은 못하는데 스킨십이 좋고 박민식이는 일 하나는 끝내주게 잘하는데 스킨십이 적다는 얘기가 있더라”며 “주민들에게 다가간다는 의미로 허리를 굽혀 한 분 한 분 인사를 드리고 있다”고 말했다. 한 주민은 차를 세우더니 창문을 내리고 “그래도 북구 사람 뽑아줘야 되지 않겠나”라고 했다.)

In an interview with this newspaper at his campaign office after street campaigning, Candidate Park targeted Democratic Party candidate Ha Jung-woo and independent candidate Han Dong-hoon, saying, "Those two who came down just a month ago—what do they know? In Busan dialect, 'Are you looking down on Buk-gu?'" He added, "As the People Power Party candidate carrying the Number 2 symbol, conservative unity has already begun around Park Min-shik." (박 후보는 거리 유세 이후 선거 캠프에서 본지와 가진 인터뷰에서 민주당 하정우, 무소속 한동훈 후보를 겨냥해 “한 달 전에 내려온 두 후보가 뭘 아느냐. 부산 말로 ‘북구를 알(아래)로 보나’”라고 했다. 그러면서 “국민의힘 후보가 돼 (기호) 2번 붙이고 나온 박민식으로 보수 결집이 이미 시작됐다”고 했다.)

Regarding Democratic Party candidate Ha, he stated, "He has no political thinking or conviction." Referring to the controversy over Ha's "handshake hand-wiping," he said, "Even I, the son of a Vietnamese wife who sold vegetables at Gupo Market, was hurt by that." (그는 민주당 하 후보에 대해서는 “자기 정치에 대한 생각도, 소신도 없다”고 했다. 하 후보의 ‘악수 손 털기’ 논란을 거론하며 “구포시장에서 야채 장사를 하셨던 월남 댁(베트남전 참전 군인의 아내)의 아들인 나도 상처를 받았다”고 했다.)

About independent candidate Han, he remarked, "He says that for conservatism to be rebuilt, he needs to enter Yeouido through winning the election... It's a 'self-centered worldview'." On Han appointing former lawmaker Jeong Hyeong-geun—a three-term representative for the district—as his campaign chairman, Park asked, "Is summoning someone who stepped down as a stale conservative in the 2008 election, after 20 years, what Han calls conservative reconstruction?" (무소속 한 후보에 대해서는 “본인이 당선을 통해 여의도에 들어가야 보수가 재건된다고 하더라”며 “유아독존적 세계관”이라고 했다. 한 후보가 이 지역에서 3선 의원을 지낸 정형근 전 의원을 후원회장으로 위촉한 데 대해서는 “2008년 선거에서 이미 구태 보수로 물러나신 분을 20년 만에 소환하는 게 한 후보가 말하는 보수 재건이냐”고 했다.)

Some People Power Party lawmakers are calling for a unified conservative candidate with Han. On the 10th, Park Hyung-joon, the People Power Party's Busan mayoral candidate, said, "To win in Busan, we must end the split in Buk-gu Gap." Park Min-shik responded, "Isn't that just saying we should go with the People Power Party candidate, rather than dividing?" (일부 국민의힘 의원들은 한 후보와의 보수 후보 단일화를 주장하고 있다. 지난 10일 박형준 국민의힘 부산시장 후보는 “부산 선거에서 승리하려면 (부산) 북갑에서부터 분열을 끝내야 한다”고 했다. 박민식 후보는 “분열하지 말고 국민의힘 후보로 가자는 뜻 아니겠느냐”고 했다.)

Asked about the possibility that failure in unification could lead to Ha's election due to a split in conservative votes, he said, "Right now, Ha's approval rating is inflated by the president and Democratic Party approval rates, but as the second handshake controversy and third 'oppa' controversy emerge, his support will naturally drop." This suggests he believes he can win even in a three-way race. To both Ha and Han, he declared, "Let's have a fair fight." (단일화에 실패할 경우 보수 표 분산으로 하 후보가 당선되는 것 아니냐는 질문에는 “지금은 대통령과 민주당 지지율로 인해 하 후보 지지율에 거품이 끼어 있지만 제2의 악수, 제3의 오빠 논란이 나오며 자연스럽게 지지율은 빠질 것”이라고 했다. 3자 구도에서도 충분히 이길 수 있다는 취지다. 하·한 두 후보를 향해 “당당하게 한 판 붙자”고 했다.)

item.title: People Power Party Says, “Jeon Jae-soo’s Aides Destroyed PC with Hammer… Jeon Must Take Direct Responsibility” (국힘, “전재수 보좌진, 망치로 PC 부숴...田 직접 책임져야”)
item.description:
On the 12th, the People Power Party stated regarding the aides of Jeon Jae-soo, the Democratic Party of Korea's candidate for Busan mayor, who allegedly smashed office PCs with a hammer just before a search and seizure by investigative authorities, that “it is impossible for Jeon Jae-soo, the biggest beneficiary, not to have known,” and that “Candidate Jeon must take direct responsibility.” (국민의힘이 12일 더불어민주당 전재수 부산시장 후보의 국회의원 시절 보좌진들이 수사기관의 압수수색 직전에 사무실 PC를 망치로 부순 것에 대해 “최대 수혜자인 전재수 후보가 모를 리 없다”며 “전 후보가 직접 책임져야 한다”고 했다.)

Rep. Joo Jin-woo, the standing co-chair of the Busan Mayor Candidate Park Hyung-joon’s campaign, made this statement on his Facebook page, saying, “How could the aides have known about the detailed information of the search and seizure in advance and preemptively destroyed the PCs to conceal evidence?” (박형준 부산시장 후보 캠프 상임선대위원장인 주진우 의원은 이날 자신의 페이스북에 “내밀한 압수수색 정보를 어떻게 알고 보좌진이 미리 PC를 부수면서까지 증거를 인멸할 수 있느냐”며 이처럼 밝혔다.)

Furthermore, Rep. Joo said, “A 24-year-old intern secretary was unfairly indicted just a few months into her job, and her future will be bleak,” and added, “Candidate Jeon should not hide behind the back of a 24-year-old young intern to avoid responsibility but must take direct responsibility himself.” (그러면서 주 의원은 “24세 인턴 비서관은 근무한 지 몇 개월 만에 억울하게 기소됐고 앞날이 캄캄할 것”이라며 “전 후보는 24세 청년 인턴의 등 뒤에 숨어 책임을 면할 것이 아니라 직접 책임져야 한다”고 했다.)

Kwak Kyu-taek, the senior deputy spokesperson of the People Power Party, also issued a commentary on the same day, asking, “Who is the accomplice to Candidate Jeon’s silence, the Joint Investigation Headquarters’ connivance, and the destruction of evidence?” Rep. Kwak noted, “The indictment meticulously records the shocking circumstances of evidence destruction that occurred even before the joint investigation headquarters’ search and seizure began,” and added, “However, what is even more incomprehensible is the attitude of the Joint Investigation Headquarters.” (곽규택 국민의힘 원내수석대변인도 이날 논평을 내고 “전 후보의 침묵과 합수본의 방조, 증거인멸의 공범은 누구냐”고 했다. 곽 대변인은 “공소장에는 합동수사본부의 압수수색이 들어오기 전부터 이뤄진 충격적인 증거인멸 정황이 낱낱이 기록됐다”며 “그러나 더욱 납득할 수 없는 것은 합수본의 태도”라고 했다.)

He continued, “While the indictment details the specific circumstances of the systematic evidence destruction, it is difficult to find anywhere in the investigation whether the aides reported this fact to Rep. Jeon Jae-soo or whether there was a direct order from Rep. Jeon Jae-soo regarding the destruction of evidence,” and said, “We cannot help but ask the Joint Investigation Headquarters whether the senior secretary’s order to the intern to reset the PCs, and the systematic crime committed in coordination between the Seoul office and the Busan office, was carried out voluntarily without the permission of Rep. Jeon Jae-soo, the ultimate manager.” (이어 “조직적 증거인멸의 구체적 정황을 공소장에 적시하면서도, 보좌진이 이 사실을 전재수 의원에게 보고했는지에 대한 여부, 그리고 전재수 의원의 증거인멸에 대한 직접적 지시가 있었는지에 대한 수사는 어디에서도 확인하기 어렵다”며 “선임비서관이 인턴에게 PC 초기화를 지시하고, 서울 사무실과 부산 사무실이 연계하여 이뤄진 조직적 범행이, 최종 관리자인 전재수 의원의 허락 없이 자발적으로 이루어졌다는 말인지 합수본에 묻지 않을 수 없다”고 했다.)

According to the indictment of Candidate Jeon’s aides submitted by the joint investigation headquarters of the prosecution and police (headed by Kim Tae-hoon, chief of the Daejeon High Prosecutors’ Office) to Rep. Joo’s office, they had conspired to destroy evidence ahead of a police search and seizure in December last year. The indictment includes circumstances indicating that Candidate Jeon’s former senior secretary, identified as A, took the lead in participating in the evidence destruction. (앞서 검경 합동수사본부(본부장 김태훈 대전고검장)가 주 의원실에 제출한 전 후보 보좌진들의 공소장에 따르면 이들은 작년 12월 경찰 압수수색을 앞두고 증거인멸을 공모한 것으로 나타났다. 공소장에는 전 후보의 의원 시절 선임비서관 A씨가 주도적으로 증거 인멸에 가담한 정황이 담겼다.)

According to the indictment, the aides dismantled the office PCs, smashed the hard disks with hammers, and discarded them in a nearby field and a bathhouse trash can. Five days before the search and seizure, on December 10 last year, A instructed an intern secretary to reset the PCs at the Busan office. He stated, “We must not create anything that could be criticized by the investigative authorities.” (공소장에 따르면 보좌진들은 의원실 PC를 해체하고 하드디스크를 망치 등으로 부순 뒤 인근 밭과 목욕탕 쓰레기통에 버렸다. A씨는 압수수색이 있기 5일 전인 지난해 12월 10일 인턴 비서관에게 부산 사무실 PC들을 초기화하라고 지시했다. 그는 “수사기관에 책잡힐 일을 만들면 안 된다”고 했다.)

A discarded a SSD, which the intern secretary had removed from the PC, into an office trash can. He then dismantled an HDD using a screwdriver and struck it with a hammer. Another SSD was bent with hands and feet. The broken HDD was reportedly discarded in a field near his residence, and the bent SSD was thrown into a trash can at a bathhouse in Busan. The Joint Investigation Headquarters reported that it had confirmed charges against four of Rep. Jeon’s former aides suspected of evidence destruction and indicted them without detention. (A씨는 인턴 비서관이 PC에서 분리해 둔 SSD를 사무실 쓰레기통에 버렸다. 이후 HDD(하드디스크)를 드라이버를 이용해 해체한 후 이를 망치로 내리치기도 했다. 또 다른 SSD는 손과 발로 구부러뜨렸다. 부서진 HDD는 주거지 인근 밭에, 구부러뜨린 SSD는 부산의 한 목욕탕 쓰레기통에 버린 것으로 알려졌다. 합수본은 증거 인멸 의혹을 받는 전 의원의 보좌진 4명에 대해 혐의가 확인됐다고 보고 불구속기소 했다.)

In response to this, Candidate Jeon previously stated in an interview with this newspaper last month, “I only found out belatedly that my aides had done such a thing. I immediately ordered a recovery,” and added, “As suspicions arose in the media, I think they were scared and destroyed the materials. It’s a shame that this situation happened; there is some regret.” (이에 대해 전 후보는 앞서 지난달 본지 인터뷰에서 “보좌진이 그런 일을 한 걸 뒤늦게 알았다. 즉각적으로 복구 지시를 했다”며 “언론 등에서 의혹이 불거지니 겁도 나고 해서 자료를 소실한 것 같다. 이런 일이 없었으면 좋았을 텐데 아쉬운 건 있다”고 했다.)

item.title: Han Byung-do on People Power Party's 'Munu-ho' Offensive: "Begging for Votes with National Security...a Traitorous Attempt" (한병도, 국힘 ‘나무호’ 공세에 “안보 팔아 표 구걸...매국적 시도”)
item.description:
Democratic Party of Korea floor leader Han Byung-do said on the 12th regarding the attack on the South Korean-flagged vessel Munu-ho in the Strait of Hormuz on the 4th, which resulted in a fire, "The People Power Party is spreading baseless, near-delusional rumors, not only damaging the government but also endangering the people and undermining national interests and the South Korea-U.S. alliance." <<> Floor leader Han stated this during a party leadership meeting, saying, "The People Power Party must immediately stop its reckless actions of begging for votes by holding national security hostage." Regarding the People Power Party's allegations of government cover-up and concealment over the Munu-ho attack, Han said, "The People Power Party is once again using national interests and national security as tools for partisan advantage. They are turning this into a political battle, calling it a national security disaster even before the exact investigation results into the Munu-ho fire have been released." <<> Floor leader Han stated that the government has already revealed through its on-site investigation that the Munu-ho was hit by two unidentified aircraft and is making every effort to determine the cause, including additional analysis of the launch entity and aircraft type. He added, "Our government and the Democratic Party hold a firm and unified stance that attacks on civilian vessels cannot be justified or tolerated." <<> He then pointed out, "Yet the People Power Party claims the government's response was slow and its explanations ambiguous. Representative Jang Dong-hyuk even did not hesitate to say that the word 'Iran' was missing from the investigation results." He added, "Hastily identifying the attacker without precise scientific evidence could endanger the 26 South Korean ships stranded in the Strait of Hormuz." <<> Floor leader Han also said, "The People Power Party has even gone so far as to undermine trust in the South Korea-U.S. alliance, publicly stating unverified information as fact, claiming that 'even through South Korea-U.S. cooperation and a hotline, the launch point of the aircraft could not be quickly confirmed.' What country's political party is the People Power Party?" He added, "The Democratic Party will firmly confront this traitorous attempt to hold not only national security but also diplomatic relations hostage to partisan strife. We will steadfastly join the government in verifying facts through precise investigation and protecting national interests." <<> Floor leader Han, who held his first leadership meeting with the newly formed third-term floor leadership team on this day, also pledged victory in the June 3 local elections, which are now 22 days away. He said, "It is now time to replace the local power that ruined our regions, backed by Yoon Suk Yeol. The incompetent and irresponsible local power of Yoon Suk Yeol will be judged at the ballot box." He added, "Victory in the June 3 local elections will complete the revolution of light started by the great people." (한병도 더불어민주당 원내대표는 지난 4일 호르무즈 해협에서 한국 국적 선박 나무호가 피격을 받아 화재를 입은 것과 관련해 “국민의힘이 아무 근거도 없는 망상에 가까운 괴담을 퍼뜨리며 정부를 흠집 내는 것도 모자라 국민을 위험에 몰아넣고 국익과 한미 동맹까지 훼손하고 있다”고 12일 말했다.)

item.title: President Lee: "Money Not Circulating Is the Problem... Austerity Budget Is Populism" (李대통령 “돈이 안돌아 문제… 긴축재정이 포퓰리즘”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung said on the 12th, "Now is the time to boost potential through investment, and if we invest, it will return with greater rewards," adding, "We must focus our capabilities on laying the foundation for a great leap forward in the national economy through an active fiscal policy." President Lee made these remarks during a cabinet meeting held at the presidential office, stating, "Based on this stance, I ask you to approach the formulation of the second-half economic growth strategy and the preparation of next year's budget." (이재명 대통령은 12일 “지금은 투자를 통해 잠재력을 키울 시기이며, 투자를 하면 더 큰 보상으로 돌아온다”며 “적극 재정을 통해 국민 경제 대도약의 발판을 닦는 데 역량을 집중해야 한다”고 했다. 이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 주재한 국무회의에서 “이런 기조를 바탕으로 하반기 경제성장 전략 수립과 내년도 예산 편성에 임해달라”며 이같이 말했다.)

President Lee said, "Research results have confirmed that active fiscal management provides practical momentum to the people's economy. It is said that last year, every 1 million won in livelihood recovery consumption coupons generated an additional 430,000 won in economic effects," and "Various other analyses have consistently demonstrated that bold fiscal injections invigorate the overall economy." (이 대통령은 “적극적인 재정 운영이 민생 경제에 실질적 동력을 제공한다는 점이 연구 결과로 확인됐다. 지난해 지급된 민생회복 소비 쿠폰 100만원당 추가로 43만원의 경제 효과를 거뒀다고 한다”며 “다른 여러 분석에서도 과감한 재정 투입이 경제 전반에 활력을 불어넣는다는 점이 일관되게 입증되고 있다”고 밝혔다.)

He particularly noted, "Despite these objective facts, there are voices from some quarters that insist on austerity like a broken record," adding, "While they cite national debt as a justification, it is an irresponsible voice that calls for us to stand by and watch the suffering of the people." He continued, "If you look at the real debt, considering not the nominal debt of our country but the actual debt and bonds, it is about 10% of GDP," and "This means our national debt structure is sounder than any other country." (특히 “이런 객관적 사실에도 마치 돌림노래처럼 긴축을 강요하는 목소리가 일각에서 존재한다”며 “국가 채무를 명분으로 들고 있지만, 민생의 고통을 수수방관하라는 무책임한 목소리”라고 했다. 이어 “우리나라의 명목상 채무가 아닌 실제 채무와 채권이 얼마나 있는지를 따진 실질적 채무를 살펴보면 국내총생산(GDP) 대비 10% 정도”라며 “다른 어느 나라보다 국가 채무 구조가 우량하다는 뜻”이라고 했다.)

He further stated, "There was a time when thrift was a virtue, but now society's problem is that money is not circulating. Consumption has become a virtue," and "We must not fall into the trap of populist austerity budget theory that deceives the people." President Lee emphasized, "I am not saying we should spend recklessly at any time, nor that we should keep taking on debt," but "In times like these, it is the government's role to ensure the economy circulates through investment." (그러면서 “한때 절약이 미덕일 때가 있었지만, 지금은 돈이 안 돌아서 문제인 사회가 됐다. 소비가 미덕인 시대가 된 것”이라며 “국민의 눈을 속이는 포퓰리즘적인 긴축재정론의 함정에 빠져서는 안 된다”고 했다. 이 대통령은 “아무 때나 막 쓰자는 것이 아니다. 자꾸 빚을 낼 일도 아니다”라면서도 “이럴 때는 투자를 통해 경제가 순환하게 하는 게 정부의 역할”이라고 거듭 강조했다.)

Meanwhile, President Lee criticized whether it was right for the private bad bank 'Sangnoksu', established during the credit card crisis of 2002-2003, to "aggressively collect debts that are over 20 years old." Financial Services Commission Chairman Lee Eok-won responded, "It is passive due to the aspect where profit is involved." (한편 이 대통령은 지난 2002~2003년 카드 대란 당시 설립된 민간 배드뱅크 ‘상록수’가 “20년 넘은 빚을 악착같이 추심하는 것이 맞느냐”고 비판했다. 이억원 금융위원장은 “이익이 뒤에 자리 잡은 그런 측면 때문에 소극적”이라고 답했다.)

President Lee said, "It seems there is a private bad bank called Sangnoksu. It was set up to manage non-performing loans from the credit card crisis, but it seems it is still actively collecting them," and "During the credit card crisis, didn't the credit card companies receive help from government taxes?" He added, "It seems they are still aggressively collecting overdue debts, earning tens of trillions in annual operating profits, and even receiving dividends from it." (이 대통령은 “민간 배드뱅크 상록수가 있나 보다. 카드 사태 때 발생한 부실 채권을 정리한다고 연체 채권을 모아서 관리하는 곳인데 아직도 열심히 추심하고 있나 보다”라면서 “카드 사태 때 카드 회사들은 정부 세금으로 도움받지 않았나”라며 “악착같이 연체 채권을 지금도 추심하고, 연간 수십조 영업이익을 내면서 그것도 배당받고 있는 것 같다”고 했다.)

Financial Services Commission Chairman Lee Eok-won explained, "We are operating the New Leap Fund to manage financial institutions' long-term overdue debts and are continuously purchasing debts," adding, "99.4% of financial institutions have joined a voluntary agreement with the New Leap Fund to proceed with debt purchases and halt collections." He continued, "On the surface, since it is a corporation formed by multiple institutions, we need consent from all shareholders, which makes it difficult," but responded, "It is passive due to the aspect where profit is involved." (이억원 금융위원장은 “금융기관 장기 연체 채권 정리를 위해 새도약기금을 운영하고 있고 계속 채권을 매입하고 있다”면서 “새도약기금에 99.4% 금융기관이 자발적 협약에 가입해 채권 매입과 추심 중단을 진행 중”이라고 설명했다. 이어 “표면적으로는 여러 기관이 모여서 만든 주식회사다 보니까 주주 전체의 동의를 받아야 해서 어려움이 있다”면서도 “이익이 뒤에 자리하고 있는 측면 때문에 소극적”이라고 답했다.)

President Lee said, "We cannot force it. It is private property, but there should be a measure to it," and "Claiming to practice moral and ethical management while enjoying benefits and avoiding burdens is not right." He added, "They are not loan sharks; aren't financial institutions operating with government issuing power?" and "It involves licensing or authorization." (이 대통령은 “억지로 할 수는 없다. 사유재산인데 그래도 정도가 있다”면서도 “도덕 경영, 윤리 경영 한다고 하면서 혜택은 누리고 부담은 안 지려는 건 맞지 않는다”고 했다. 이어 “사채업자도 아니고 금융기관은 정부 발권력으로 하는 것 아니냐”며 “면허나 인가로 하는 측면이 있다”고 덧붙였다.)

President Lee instructed the Financial Services Commission Chairman to "find a solution, even through legislation if necessary." Chairman Lee responded, "Sangnoksu is not an individual financial company but a structure funded by contributions to a securitization company," and "The financial authorities have sent cooperation requests and official documents, and some media have even described it as threats." He continued, "I will meet with the shareholders separately to seek their consent," adding, "Some institutions (such as Shinhan Card) have already offered to sell. I believe they will agree if we meet individually." (이 대통령은 금융위원장에게 “필요하면 입법으로라도 해결 방법을 찾아보자”고 지시했다. 이 원장은 “(상록수는) 개별 금융회사가 아니라 유동화 회사에 출자해 만든 구조”라며 “금융 당국이 협조 요청과 공문 발송도 했고, 일부 언론에서는 협박이라고 표현하기도 했다”고 답했다. 이어 “주주들을 별도로 만나 동의를 구해보겠다”면서 “일부 기관(신한카드)은 본인이 먼저 매각하겠다고 했다. 개별적으로 만나면 동의할 것이라고 생각한다”고 답했다.)

On the morning of the cabinet meeting in progress, following Shinhan Card, Hana Bank also decided to sell overdue debts held by the private bad loan management company 'Sangnoksu' to the New Leap Fund. (실제 국무회의가 진행되고 있는 이날 오전 신한카드에 이어 하나은행도 민간 부실 채권 처리 회사인 ‘상록수’가 보유한 장기 연체 채권을 새도약기금에 매각하기로 결정했다.)

When overdue debts are sold to the New Leap Fund, a bad bank, collections from borrowers are immediately halted. Subsequently, debt adjustments or installment repayments are promoted based on repayment ability. Sangnoksu is a private bad loan management company established in October 2003 by the financial sector to manage bad debts that surged due to the credit card crisis. Shinhan Card holds a 30% stake. Hana Bank, IBK Industrial Bank, Woori Card, and others each hold a 10% stake. (배드뱅크인 새도약기금에 연체 채권이 매각되면 차주에 대한 추심은 즉시 중단된다. 이후 상환 능력에 따라 채무 조정이나 분할 상환이 추진된다. 상록수는 카드 대란으로 신용 불량자가 늘어난 2003년 10월 금융권이 부실 채권 정리를 위해 만든 민간 부실 채권 처리 회사다. 신한카드는 30%의 지분을 갖고 있다. 하나은행·IBK기업은행·우리카드 등이 각 10%의 지분을 보유 중이다.)
